card.name: Linking words in news and academic prose
card.fires_on: Commas, prepositions and verbs in general web prose about research, history or policy. It marks the point just after a person, group or study is named and a description or attribution comes next.

modes.label: Comma after a named source
modes.description: A comma right after a researcher's name, before their job title or role.
modes.example: says McKinley<<,>> an assistant professor of atmospheric and oceanic

modes.label: Linking word after a subject
modes.description: A preposition or verb such as with, in, written or co after an agent or group, leading to a role or relationship.
modes.example: working in concert<< with>> DNR's Nature Tourism Program, is

card.plain: It fires on small joining words and commas in news or academic writing, where a name is about to be followed by a description or a role.
